Redact Detected PII Entities from Text

Source: R/pii.R
pii_redact.Rd

Deterministically replaces detected PII spans with non-reversible typed placeholders (default "[REDACTED_{TYPE}]"). Preserves NA_character_ elements and attaches an aggregate-only "pii_report" attribute containing zero raw sensitive values.

Usage

pii_redact(
  text,
  config = pii_config(),
  replacement = "[REDACTED_{TYPE}]",
  return_details = FALSE
)

Arguments

text

Character vector of documents to redact.

config

An pii_config() configuration object.

replacement

Character scalar replacement template. {TYPE} is substituted with the uppercased entity type (e.g., "[REDACTED_EMAIL]").

return_details

Logical scalar; if TRUE, returns a list with text and report (airgap_privacy_report); if FALSE (default), returns the redacted character vector with attr(out, "pii_report").

Value

A redacted character vector (or list when return_details = TRUE).

Examples

pii_redact("Patient: Jane Doe (SSN 123-45-6789) emailed jane@example.org.")
#> [1] "Patient: [REDACTED_PERSON_NAME] (SSN [REDACTED_SSN]) emailed [REDACTED_EMAIL]."
#> attr(,"pii_report")
#> <airgap_privacy_report> (aggregate counts only; zero raw PII)
#>   Documents scanned:  1
#>   Documents with PII: 1 (100%)
#>   Total detections:   3
#>   By entity type:
#>     - email: 1 (1 docs, 100%)
#>     - person_name: 1 (1 docs, 100%)
#>     - ssn: 1 (1 docs, 100%)
